top_signals.title: The Iran War Could And Should Be Over Tomorrow Says Blinken
top_signals.summary: Former Secretary of State Antony Blinken joined Balance of Power with Joe Mathieu to discuss rapid AI advancement and whether guardrails should be in place. Blinken said, 'If you've got the wizards telling you all ain't right in Oz, listen to them.' He also noted he believes the war involving Iran could end tomorrow with diplomacy. (Source: Bloomberg)
